suggested_requirements.text: The system shall provide an Exploring College page listing computer science offerings from Oregon University System campuses and other Oregon colleges.
The system shall provide a Jobs & Money page answering questions about societal contribution and salary potential with a computer science degree.
The system shall provide a Real People page featuring profiles of recent CS graduates and experienced professionals.
The system shall provide a Women in Computer Science page profiling women computer scientists and engineers.
The system shall provide a Resources page exploring pre-college technology programs and courses for high school students.
The system shall provide an I’m Looking For page containing a list of focused questions and answers.
The system shall provide an Articles page listing external articles related to computer science careers.
The system shall provide a High School Courses page showing recommended curricula for students interested in CS.
The system shall provide an internal search function for the Get Real site.
The system shall provide an external search function for CS-related outside sites.
The system shall provide a Professional Organizations page listing links to organizations such as ACM and IEEE.
The system shall provide RSS feeds of current CS information.
The system shall provide an Ask a Grad or Prof FAQ section.
The system shall provide a Consider a CS Minor page with information for students in other professions.
The website must be teen-friendly and easy to navigate.
The website must use short paragraphs, bullets, and charts to accommodate short reader attention spans.
The website must be hosted on a server that provides rapid response time.
The website must adhere to the copyright and security measures of the OUS site.
The website must be tested against IE, Firefox, and Netscape browsers.
The system must track and evaluate hits and time spent on the website.
The website design must be consistent with the standards and conventions used on the OUS site.
